decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (2012/28/P03A, 2012/28/P04A, 2012/28/P05A, 2012/28/P06A received 28 September 2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 33 Lingwood Gardens

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The first floor windows in the side wall of the two-storey side extension shall be obscure glazed as shown on the approved drawings, and permanently retained as such.
description: Erection of a two storey side and rear extension with additional single storey rear extension at the property
